name: Ostovite Nest
description: A nest of bones resembling an ant hill contains countless miniscule scavenger vermin with vicious, acid-dripping mandibles.
disable: DC 18 Athletics check (trained) to topple the mound and destroy it
reset: The hazard deactivates if there are no targets for its acid spew at the start of its turn. The hatchlings return to the nest, and the hazard resets. If damaged but not destroyed, the nest recovers 1d6 healing Hit Points per hour as the hatchlings repair it.
routine: (1 action) The hazard makes an acid spew Strike against the nearest creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skittering Surge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 15 feet of the nest

Effect A mass of skittering ostovite hatchlings crawls all over the nest, spewing acid in all directions. Each creature within 30 feet of the nest takes 1d10+4 acid damage (DC 18 basic Reflex save). A creature who fails the save also takes 1 persistent plus acid damage. The hazard then rolls initiative.
